name: 対象の本文と既読情報の確認
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese “message information” mobile UI on a near-square white canvas. Match the native preview’s actual 390 × 398 px frame: the canvas is only 8 px taller than it is wide (aspect ratio 0.98). Do not make a 3:4 portrait poster or a wide landscape layout. Keep all content compactly arranged within that near-square canvas, with no large blank areas.

Use the native preview for the exact frame, spacing, type scale, colors, and content positions. Use the original source crop only for the WhatsApp message-info structure. The source crop is wider than the target; do not copy its aspect ratio. No device frame, phone status bar, wallpaper, home indicator, watermark, or extra text.

Exact copy: メッセージの情報; 今日; 明日の9時に集まれますか？; 編集済み; 00:49; 既読; 未確認; 配信済み; 今日 00:50.

Follow the native preview’s positions: centered bold heading at the top; small pale-mint 今日 pill near y=70; right-aligned light-green rounded message bubble around x=145, y=124, width=229, height=94; pale-mint two-row status card around x=16, y=266, width=358, height=101. Keep the rows separated by a thin light-gray rule. The message has a single line if possible, with only about 47 px between the bubble and status card. Leave about 30 px below the card.

In the message, color only 明日の9時 blue and underline it as a hyperlink because the matching original phrase “9 am tomorrow!” is visibly underlined as a detected link. Keep に集まれますか？ dark. Place 編集済み, 00:49, and a green double-check in muted green along the bubble’s lower edge. In the status card, row one has a green double-check, dark 既読, and muted-gray 未確認 aligned right; row two has a gray double-check, dark 配信済み, and muted-gray 今日 00:50 aligned right.

Use flat, restrained pale-mint and light-green fills as in the native preview, crisp Japanese sans-serif lettering, and exact copy. Keep every label legible at the 390 × 398 reference size. The blue underlined phrase 明日の9時 is the only blue text.
reviewNotes: The date-time hyperlink 明日の9時 is blue and underlined. After two attempts, visible vertical offsets remain between the title, bubble and status card compared with the 390x398 native preview; retain needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
